defs.def: the act of communicating with sb, especially regularly （尤指经常的）联系，联络

ex.s: This form of remembered contact with a book can accompany us during a lifetime and continue to strengthen and shape us.
ex.t: 但对人类来说，意义就是一切。

ex.s: Renewed contact with a novel or a poem can activate the search for a better knowledge of the self.
ex.t: 意义是通过社会互动的过程产生的，而非计算过程，这种互动塑造了我们头脑中符号的内容。

ex.s: •Once a pair has been determined to be suitable, the students will be contacted individually with a special permission number to register for the programme.
ex.t: •一旦确定一对配对合适，将单独联系学生，提供特殊许可号码用于注册该课程。

ex.s: Make individual contact.

ex.s: Make sure you have communicated with your friend about how frequently each of you wants to be contacted and what method works best for you both. ___17___.
ex.t: 除了持续的书面沟通之外，还有其他选择，比如留言或群聊。

ex.s: This first contact was where my story began.
ex.t: 第一次接触就是我的故事的开始。

ex.s: Artist Michael Craig-Martin said: “Andria's brilliant project to bring artists from all fields into direct contact with children is particularly welcome at a time when the arts are being downgraded in schools." It was a mistake to see the arts as unnecessary, he added.
ex.t: 历史学家西蒙·沙玛爵士也是这个项目的支持者。

defs.def: the state of touching sth 触摸；接触
the state of meeting sb or having to deal with sth 遇见（某人）；碰上（要处理的事）
an occasion on which you meet or communicate with sb; a relationship with sb 会见；交往；人际关系
a person that you know, especially sb who can be helpful to you in your work 熟人；（尤指）社会关系

ex.s: They also gave us contact information for people who know them.
ex.t: 保持信息简单清晰会让人们更容易理解。___38___然而，他们是第一次听到这些信息。

defs.def: an electrical connection （电流的）接触，接通；接触器

ex.s: Words formed by combining other words are called compounds, for example, 1______ (a friend that you contact by writing, traditionally using a pen) and 2_______ (known by many people).
ex.t: 由其他词组合而成的词称为复合词，例如笔友（通过写信联系的朋友，传统上使用笔）和著名的（为许多人所知的）。

ex.s: We could also say But after a year or two we lost contact with each other.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：但过了一两年，我们就失去了联系。

ex.s: I was really surprised when a bank contacted me with a credit card offer.
ex.t: 当一家银行联系我提供信用卡时，我真的很惊讶。

ex.s: It made me realise the value of real contact that I had forgotten.
ex.t: 这让我意识到我已经忘记了真正接触的价值。

ex.s: I was caught in a dust storm and lost contact with them.
ex.t: 我遭遇了一场沙尘暴，与他们失去了联系。

defs.def: a person who may be infectious because he or she has recently been near to sb with a contagious disease （与传染病患者的）接触者
